purpose: Capture externally supplied AI explanations as hypotheses/test inputs without promoting self-reported provider internals to fact.
rule: AI-generated mechanism explanations are observations. Provider behavior is promoted only when qualifying first-party documentation or direct first-party evidence is recorded.

claims.summary: Entity/alias fragmentation and RAG chunk context loss were presented as retrieval risks.
Citation drift was described as attribution ambiguity in RAG outputs.
claims.action: measure visible source/entity attribution; do not assume internal cause

claims.summary: Suggested semantic proximity to major AI brands as a visibility tactic.
claims.action: reject as optimization rule; avoid false association/entity contamination

claims.summary: Context caching/long context was described as an indexing mechanism.
claims.action: do not treat context cache as public web index

claims.summary: Native multimodal processing and hybrid retrieval were described as model/retrieval capabilities.
claims.action: future internal retrieval research only; no external-indexing inference

claims.summary: Parallel subqueries/agents were described as retrieval architecture.
claims.action: use only as a test hypothesis unless provider-documented

claims.summary: PerplexityBot surfaces/links sites in search results and is distinct from user-triggered Perplexity-User.
claims.action: explicitly allow search crawler; observe crawler/fetch evidence separately

claims.summary: Web search, direct URL reading, archives and repositories were presented as distinct retrieval surfaces.
claims.action: separate discovery from direct URL retrieval and archive/repository observations

claims.summary: Perplexity response described AIO CODE as a methodology.
claims.action: record as entity-type resolution failure; canonical type remains DigitalEntityOperatingSystem

claims.summary: Common Crawl, Wayback, independent search and repository indexes were proposed as alternative discovery surfaces.
claims.action: treat as surface-map candidates, verify individually before operational use

claims.summary: Direct page access was distinguished from indexed search discovery.
claims.action: maintain separate direct-url retrieval and discovery tests

claims.summary: Claimed shared phone/email/device causes server-side public entity unification.
claims.action: do not use as fact or entity-resolution mechanism without Meta first-party evidence

claims.summary: Claimed Meta AI can use first-party public ecosystem content differently from external web retrieval.
claims.action: test observable Meta surfaces separately; no training inference

claims.summary: Named meta-webindexer, Meta-ExternalAgent and Meta-ExternalFetcher with distinct roles.
claims.action: do not encode provider-specific robots rules until first-party documentation is verified

claims.summary: OAI-SearchBot is used for ChatGPT search discovery; GPTBot training controls are separate; ChatGPT-User is user-triggered.
claims.action: explicitly allow OAI-SearchBot and keep search/training policies distinct

claims.summary: IndexNow accepts URL-change notifications after host ownership verification; HTTP acceptance only confirms receipt/acceptance state and does not prove indexing.
claims.action: implement after Blogger canonical update and log request/response/timestamp
